role: quantifier-free type of a tuple in a structure
notes: Set of quantifier-free formulas true of the tuple; for the empty tuple, the quantifier-free sentences true in the structure.

role: set of universal sentences entailed by a theory
notes: Universal consequences; two theories are companions when these sets agree.

role: set of universal-existential sentences entailed by a theory
notes: Sentences forall x exists y theta with theta quantifier-free.
Minus is unary; matches the ring-language column of tab:p03-qe-catalog.

role: theory of fields of characteristic p
notes: p = 0 or prime; field axioms with chi_p or all negated chi_q.

role: theory of algebraically closed fields of characteristic p
notes: Already used without a registry row in sec:qe-categoricity-01 and tab:p03-qe-catalog; same role.

role: dense linear order theory with prescribed endpoints
notes: E a subset of {b;t}; endpoints named by constants.

role: constant symbols for least and greatest elements
DLO with a unary predicate true at exactly one point
theory of ordered fields in the ordered-ring signature
notes: Field axioms, strict linear order axioms and the two compatibility axioms; the base theory of which RCF is the model completion.

role: adjoined square root of -1 over an ordered field
notes: R(i) is R[X]/(X^2+1) with i the class of X; upright i to keep it apart from index variables.

role: leading coefficient of a nonzero polynomial
notes: Used to define the order on Q(t) in which t exceeds every integer.
<_+ makes t larger than every integer; <_- is its transport by t -> -t, used in def:p03-w03-p03-020-rcf-ring-diagram.
